name: Loraine Campground
evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site pages: RV-capable STANDARD NON ELECTRIC sites 069 and 077 (back-in, 25 ft) carry 'Waterfront: Waterfront' (lead: 61-87 odd); OSM pitch nodes put 61-71 ~0-25 m from Frye Pond's west shore; Esri canopy-blind but loop road ~35 m from shore at 42.6070,-71.0920

name: Glen Maury Park
evidence: City 2026 kiosk map: rows nearest the Maury River (126-153) are tent-recommended, RV row 94-119 inland of them; Esri at 37.7275,-79.3632: lower-campground RVs ~35-50 m from the river behind a riparian tree row; 'Riverside'/'Water's Edge' are area names only

name: Riverside Campground
evidence: Esri leaf-off at 36.7842,-82.0334: southern RV row sits behind a hedge/tree row and a ~30-40 m wooded strip to the North Fork Holston; operator puts the on-river sites in its 22 tent/pop-up sites, not the 94 RV sites

name: Amelia Wildlife Management Area
evidence: Esri at 37.4674,-77.9110: pin on the WMA's inland fields, nearest small pond ~450 m S; DWR bars camping within 300 ft of a lake or boat ramp (AWH 2026-10-21), so no legal camp spot is on the water

name: Bark Camp Recreation Area
evidence: Esri leaf-off at 36.8688,-82.5268 and 36.8678,-82.5245: both loop roads ~100-200 m from Bark Camp Lake behind a continuous evergreen shore belt; lakeside clearing is the day-use/fishing-pier peninsula; rec.gov has no per-site data (FCFS)

name: Bath County Recreational Campground
evidence: Esri at 38.1870,-79.8225: east-side loop pads ~50-75 m from the 45-acre pond across open grass, rising ~7 m (USGS 3DEP: pads 607-608 m, pond 601 m); south loop by the swim beach has no pads (day use); beyond the on-water bound, open view -> lakeview

name: Totogatic Park
evidence: Washburn County per-site map (2022): sites 13-17, 47-52, 58-67 among others on the Minong Flowage shore; Esri at 46.1415,-91.9378: RVs on pads within ~20 m of the water; old pin was in woods ~250 m SW, re-pinned to OSM campground node

name: Briarcliffe RV Resort
evidence: Esri at 33.7990,-78.7509: park's NW tip reaches the ICW (old 'marina strip' read was wrong); tip pads ~15 m from water are owner 'private sites' 128-131 on the resort map; guest sites 132-138 sit ~20-25 m back behind a wooded knoll, and guests can't pick a site

name: Myrtle Beach KOA Resort
evidence: KOA site map PDF: Lakeside Loop sites 344-352 (rentable Deluxe Full Hook-Up Patio Back-In) on the Withers Swash bank with decks; Esri at 33.6838,-78.8978: back-in pads ~15-25 m from the channel behind a thin bank tree fringe; dated 2026-10-15 review: deck on the water
